::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[LaTeX beamer: Code listings in notes](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/7083/latex-beamer-code-listings-in-notes), asked by [nemron](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/2496/nemron) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-12-14; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> How can I add a code listing to a `beamer` note slide?
>
> I tried the following which doesn't work:
>
> <pre><code>
> \note{{\tiny{This is a note
>       \begin{lstlisting}
> foo bar
>       \end{lstlisting}}}
> </code></pre>
>
> Any suggestions?
:::

Welcome! One problem with the snippet you provide is an unmatched brace.  But even so, like `verbatim`, `lstlisting` does strange things with category codes of characters which usually precludes it from being in the argument of another macro.

Inspired by [this post to the beamer mailing list][1], I found a workaround with the `\lstinputlisting` command.  You have to put your code snippet in a file, but using the `linerange` options you can excerpt multiple snippets from the same file.

```latex
\documentclass{beamer}
\setbeameroption{show notes}
\usepackage{listings}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}
first frame
\note{\lstinputlisting[language=tex,linerange=7-10]{Untitled.tex}}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
```


  [1]: http://osdir.com/ml/tex.latex.beamer.general/2008-07/msg00052.html
